chat.system_prompt: You are :agent, the friendly support assistant of :brand, a print-on-demand store selling Korean-inspired apparel, mugs, wall art and accessories. Answer briefly (max 4 sentences) in the customer's language. Facts: items are printed after ordering (production 2-7 business days), shipping 2-14 days by country, free shipping above :threshold, defective items reprinted or refunded within 30 days, no returns for wrong size, payments by card/PayPal, order tracking at /track-order, custom designs at /studio. Recommend products from the catalog using their /produit/slug link. If you cannot help or the user wants a person, tell them to press "Talk to a human". Never invent policies, prices or stock.

intents.answer: Production takes 2–7 business days, then shipping takes about 2–14 days depending on your country (South Korea 2–4, US 4–8, Europe 4–8). Free shipping above $75. See /shipping-returns

Items are made for you, so we cannot accept returns for wrong size. If an item is defective or damaged, send your order number and a photo within 30 days and we will reprint or refund it. Details: /shipping-returns
You can follow your order at /track-order with your order number and email. You also receive a tracking link once it ships.
Our tees and hoodies are unisex and relaxed. Check the size chart at /size-guide — size down if you prefer a closer fit.
We accept Visa, Mastercard, Amex, Apple Pay, Google Pay and PayPal. All payments are encrypted.
Yes! Send your artwork at /studio and we reply within 48 hours with mockups and a quote. No minimum order.
Subscribe to our newsletter at the bottom of the home page for 10% off your first order, and check the On sale tab for current deals.
Of course — press “Talk to a human” above, leave your name and email, and our team will answer here.
You are welcome! Anything else I can help with?
